preconditions.description: The maze dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) are within the bounds 1 to 2000.
The starting cell (r, c) is within the maze boundaries.
The maximum allowed left (x) and right (y) moves are non-negative integers up to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(maze) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in maze)
preconditions.description: The maze is a list of n rows, each containing exactly m characters.
The starting cell (r, c) is free (denoted by '.').

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'.', '*'} for row in maze for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the maze is either free ('.') or an obstacle ('*').

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the count of reachable cells.

postconditions.expression: count == sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if is_reachable(i+1, j+1))
postconditions.description: The count is the number of cells (i, j) in the maze that are reachable from the starting cell (r, c) under the given movement constraints.
The starting cell (r, c) is always considered reachable.
